actions.headline_en: Press 2: Cone hydraulic fault. Check the cone hydraulics now.
actions.headline_ms: Penekan 2: Kerosakan hidraulik kon. Semak hidraulik kon sekarang.

reasons.text_en: Cone hydraulic pressure is 5% above Press 2's normal
reasons.text_ms: Tekanan hidraulik kon 5% lebih tinggi daripada biasa bagi Penekan 2

reasons.text_en: Motor current is 0% below Press 2's normal
reasons.text_ms: Arus motor 0% lebih rendah daripada biasa bagi Penekan 2

reasons.text_en: Oil lost in fibre is 2.5% (alarm line is 4%)
reasons.text_ms: Kehilangan minyak dalam serabut ialah 2.5% (garis amaran 4%)
